acceptance_criteria_results.criterion: The divergence no longer reproduces and the code realises the normative elements cited: ADD v1.3 §3.2: canonical-ingestion-envelope:1.2, 29 required fields, mandatory second payload validation; LLD v1.1 §2.5: closed envelope; producer signs envelope and digest; FR-069: envelope with eventId, source, schema version, times, aggregate identity, classification and provenance; FR-068; FR-006

The divergence no longer reproduces and the code realises the normative elements cited: LLD v1.1 §2.5 failure taxonomy and replay rules; ADD v1.3 C5 operations Publish, Subscribe, Replay, Quarantine; ADD v1.3 §3.8 Event Subscription Contract via port Subscribe; FR-074: distinguish transient, permanent, policy-denied and poison; FR-016 (MVP): subscription/change feed; FR-072 (MVP): replay preserving schema and provenance

The divergence no longer reproduces and the code realises the normative elements cited: LLD v1.1 §2.5: quotas per tenant and priority class; audit/security never dropped; LLD v1.1 §2.5: PERMANENT -> immutable DLQ; LLD v1.1 §5.1: ResourceClass CONTROL/INTERACTIVE/BATCH/AUDIT determines quota, priority and backpressure; NFR-079: backpressure and priority without disabling authentication, policy, audit

ambiguities_resolved_fail_closed: the reason codes of the second payload validation are not enumerated by the norm: invalid payload SCHEMA_VIOLATION, absent schema UNKNOWN_SCHEMA, discordant digest SCHEMA_DIGEST_MISMATCH, all PERMANENT with a dead letter; payload digest PAYLOAD_DIGEST_MISMATCH and signature SIGNATURE_INVALID
the producer signature covers the envelope without integrity.signature_ref, which is the content reference of the signature

a transport principal mismatch is quarantined POLICY_DENIED with an Audit Record; an exhausted retry budget is RETRY_BUDGET_EXHAUSTED without a dead letter (the event stays in the producer outbox); the release from the operator gate is authorised by the policy port as ReprocessAuthorized

marking_digest is the sha256 of the RFC 8785 bytes of the marking object without its own marking_digest member (ADD v1.3 :408-411 does not name the bytes; an object cannot cover its own digest); at the C5 admission boundary a mismatch is DENY, quarantined POLICY_DENIED with reason GOVERNED_CONTEXT_MISMATCH and an Audit Record (ADD v1.3 :199, :406, :411); in the C3 relay an unresolvable reference or a mismatching digest is MARKING_UNRESOLVED before any signature or publish

the relayed event context is the commit context with effective_principal_id set to the relay's authenticated transport principal, appended to actor_chain (ADD v1.3 :197, :844); governed_context_digest is the digest of that record and the relay reproduces it (ADD v1.3 :845); the commit context and its digest stay in the payload and every C4 projector verifies them

event_id and causation_id are RFC 9562 v5 UUIDs (fixed OCOR namespace) of the outbox event ID and of the action instance, because the envelope requires format uuid and C3 identifiers are URNs; the originals stay in idempotency_key, source.source_record_id and the payload

aggregate_type_id is urn:ocor:aggregate-type:<C3 aggregate type>, world_ref urn:ocor:world:<branch>, provenance_ref the GatePackage digest, CDC operation CREATE for revision 1 and UPDATE otherwise, before_digest null (not carried by the C3 event), after_digest the state digest; canonical-state-committed is ResourceClass CONTROL

a dead letter of the attempt that reaches the poison threshold (3) and of every later attempt is POISON and opens a POISON quarantine of the event unless one is open (LLD v1.1 :163); earlier attempts stay PERMANENT (LLD v1.1 :161)

ReprocessAuthorized of a dead letter (ADD v1.3 :286) is gated by an open POISON quarantine (OPERATOR_GATE_CLOSED), authorised by the replay decision of the policy port with a declared reason and authority (REPLAY_DENIED otherwise), audited, and re-admits the stored envelope and signature through every admission check under the transport principal of the producer channel; an already durable event is a duplicate (LLD v1.1 :165)
publish_with_backpressure requires the tenant argument to equal the envelope tenant_id (ADD v1.3 :199: a discordant body value is never corrected; GOVERNED_CONTEXT_MISMATCH)

journal recovery fails closed with the transient journal error when the offsets answer names no partition, or partitions other than those of the topic, instead of reading it as an empty journal (LLD v1.1 :165, durable deduplication)
